subject.name: Secretaries and administrative assistants, except legal, medical and executive
subject.summary: General secretaries and administrative assistants (O*NET 43-6014) handle scheduling, document drafting, records maintenance and call information handling; they do not include the specialised duties of executive, legal or medical secretaries. Material access and sending follow employer authorization.
